: selling price = cost x (1 + margin) = 100 x (1 + 25%) = 125 CNY.
Gross profit = 125 - 100 = 25 CNY; profit margin = 25/125 = 20.0% (note: a 25% margin here means a 25% markup on cost, which corresponds to a 20% margin on the selling price).
Conversely, with selling price 125 and cost 100, the profit margin is 20.0% and the markup is 25.0%.
